title: Linear Arboricity conjecture
statement: Linear Arboricity conjecture · Akiyama, Exoo, and Harary, 1980. A graph’s edges can be partitioned into at most ceil((Δ+1)/2) linear forests.

counterexample.description: A connected maximum-degree-seven graph that cannot be decomposed into four linear forests. A complete check exhausts all bounded edge partitions with degree and cycle pruning.
